name: Microsoft PlayFab
description: Microsoft PlayFab Server API for title data, player profiles and data, statistics and leaderboards, inventory and virtual currency, and server-side CloudScript execution.

credential_fields.name: title_id
credential_fields.label: Title ID
credential_fields.description: PlayFab title ID, used as the API hostname prefix.

credential_fields.name: secret_key
credential_fields.label: Title Secret Key
credential_fields.description: Server secret key from PlayFab Game Manager. Keep this credential strictly server-side.

tools.name: get_title_data
tools.description: Read title-wide key/value configuration data. With no keys, PlayFab returns all title data visible to the server API.

tools.name: get_player_combined_info
tools.description: Retrieve selected account, profile, statistic, inventory, and player-data sections for one PlayFab player.

tools.name: update_user_data
tools.description: Set or remove server-authorized custom data keys for a PlayFab player.

tools.name: update_player_statistics
tools.description: Write one or more named statistic values for a PlayFab player, optionally using versioned statistics.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Read a page of a PlayFab statistic leaderboard from a zero-based start position.

tools.name: get_user_inventory
tools.description: Get a PlayFab player's legacy Economy inventory and current virtual-currency balances.

tools.name: grant_items_to_user
tools.description: Grant catalog item IDs to a player's legacy PlayFab Economy inventory. This is intended for titles already using the legacy catalog API.

tools.name: modify_user_virtual_currency
tools.description: Add or subtract a specified amount of legacy PlayFab virtual currency for a player.

Amount.description: Positive to add currency, negative to subtract it.

VirtualCurrency.description: Two-character virtual-currency code configured for the title.

tools.name: execute_cloud_script
tools.description: Execute a server-side PlayFab CloudScript function for a player and return its result, logs, and execution metrics.

tools.name: get_catalog_items
tools.description: List items from a legacy PlayFab Economy catalog version for titles that still use the classic catalog.
